name: 3D Photo Album
description: A highly realistic, interactive 3D photo album with fluid page-turning physics using React Native Reanimated.
longDescription: A completely custom-built 3D photo album that simulates a physical hardcover book. It features dynamic spine shading, 3D page bending physics, perfectly mapped double-sided pages, and depth-based shadowing, all powered by React Native Reanimated and Gesture Handler.
features: Interactive pan gesture to turn pages smoothly
Realistic 3D bending physics using matrix transforms
Dynamic drop shadows and spine creases
Double-sided pages with synchronized opacity toggles
Zero external 3D engine dependencies (built on Reanimated)

props.name: pages
props.description: An array of React nodes to render as pages. The first node is the front cover, the last node is the back cover.

usage.title: Basic Usage
usage.description: Pass an array of components (e.g., Images or custom Views) to the PhotoAlbum. It automatically handles the 3D rendering and gesture interactions.

steps: Copy PhotoAlbum.tsx to your components folder
